exact_statement: For every n, quadratic q on the uniform binary cube, linear address M, independent physical sign data y_z, and E of at most twelve vertices in one fiber of M, F(x,y)=(-1)^q(x)(1-2*1_E(x))*y_(Mx) satisfies H(F)<=(4+2/ln(2))*(I(F)-1). Moreover, for a quadratic polar matrix Q, Q_i nonzero, P={partial_i q=1}, and g=(-1)^q*(1-2*1_E), every original physical j!=i with Q_ij=0 and Q_j outside span(Q_i) satisfies Inf_j(g)>=1/4-2*|E intersect P^c|/2^n. If E is contained in P and a physical set J consists of such j with Q_jk=0 for every j,k in J, querying all J in any fixed order is K4-good on every history and gives H(g)<=K*sum_j Inf_j(g)+average_a H(g|J=a) and I(g)=sum_j Inf_j(g)+average_a I(g|J=a), K=4+2/ln(2).
hypotheses: Uniform cube; base-two entropy; actual Boolean phases and original physical influence.
Twelve-edit theorem: edits in one linear-address fiber, independent physical data labels.
One tangent step: nonzero Q_i, Q_ij=0, Q_j not in span(Q_i); e_out<=2^n/32 suffices for K4 payment.
Whole tangent block: E subset P and pairwise Q_jk=0; full residual leaf entropies remain unpaid.
